text:
maya: quick question — we're standardizing how the SDK surfaces API errors into exceptions and how to attach request IDs for streaming and regular requests. trying to make a small doc for consumers, want opinions on patterns.
chris: +1. core things: stable exception types, carrying upstream request id (X-Request-Id), and not swallowing stream partial failures. short example?
sam: fwiw in node we had a nasty bug where the stream emits an 'error' with no req id. best practice: log / re-emit with the id you received from the API if present.
maya: example idea for mapping table: 401 -> AuthError (include oauth token hint), 429 -> RateLimitError (retry-after), 5xx -> ServerError (do not auto-retry except idempotent endpoints). thoughts?
li-zhang: agree. add transient-network -> RetryableNetworkError. for streaming: differentiate final-stream-error vs mid-stream-chunk-error. mid-stream should surface a StitchableStreamError with request_id so client can resume if we support resume.
raul: suggestion for debug logs: always log pair (client_request_id, server_request_id). client_request_id comes from SDK call context; server_request_id is API header X-Request-Id. Both strings.
maya: here's a tiny Python pseudo for raising mapped exceptions:
```python
# on HTTP response path
if status == 401:
    raise AuthError(msg, client_request_id=cid, server_request_id=headers.get('X-Request-Id'))
elif status == 429:
    raise RateLimitError(msg, retry_after=headers.get('Retry-After'), client_request_id=cid)
elif 500 <= status < 600:
    raise ServerError(msg, server_request_id=headers.get('X-Request-Id'))
```
chris: nice. for streaming we should also include the chunk seq#/offset in logs so ops can tell where it died.
sam: node streaming snippet — attach id to stream object so listeners can reference it:
```js
const s = sdk.stream(...);
s.requestId = resp.headers.get('x-request-id') || clientId;
s.on('error', (err) => {
  logger.error('stream error', { err, requestId: s.requestId, chunkSeq: err.chunkSeq })
});
```
li-zhang: about retries: SDK should expose two knobs: automatic idempotent retries + manual retry helper that preserves client_request_id across retries. preserve client id so logs correlate.
maya: ops-bot — can you remind infra teams to guarantee X-Request-Id is returned for streaming endpoints? we had intermittent misses last week.
ops-bot: noted. I filed INFRA-892, pinged streaming infra. will follow up in the thread. :eyes:
raul: language nuance: in Go we rely on context.Context for request id propagation; include it in middleware so any downstream logs auto-attach. example: ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, "request-id", id)
sam: and mention jittered backoff for 429s in the docs. small pseudo: backoff = base * 2**attempt * (1 + jitter()).
chris: one more: make exception __repr__ include both ids and endpoint path. helps when users paste stack traces into support.
maya: agree. i'll draft a short PR that adds these types + tiny logging helpers and attach RFC. planning to include: mapping table, code snippets for py/js/go, and a one-paragraph streaming policy (resume vs abort). anyone want to co-author?
li-zhang: i'll review + add go snippet.
raul: can do the ops bits (headers and chunk seq).
sam: i'll add node tests for error propagation.
maya: thanks all — will open PR in a few hours. leaving this thread open for comments. :thumbsup:
